title: LiME-native shared-adapter output View chart
native_physical_object: Native LiME frozen base and one paid PEFT module delta(x), with its original zero-parameter routing and Auto Top-K
mirror_insertion: K small m_e selecting a structured block-Givens/shear/orthogonal-Mirror transform of the already computed shared PEFT output, optionally compressing native p_e
logical_multiplicity: K useful task/expert functions from one physical PEFT pass beyond native LiME modulation
hypothesis: Replacing or augmenting native LiME's per-expert p_e with a short structured m improves useful heldout task loss or total adapter-bank storage beyond an identical-code-count ordinary diagonal/linear compression at no more than 10% P95 overhead. Native LiME's shared PEFT, parameter-free router, ngram and AutoTopK are not Mirror novelties.
implementation_steps: CPU source-only fixture: 64->128->32 shared feature extractor + one 32->8->32 PEFT, K=5 different binary labels per image, native explicit 32-vector p_e, 4-vector linear p_e and 4-vector structured Givens/shear m; train 350 AdamW updates, batch128, same init and data stream, 3 dev and 5 fresh independent digit partitions. Pin one-PEFT call counter; preserve ordinary independent multihead, independent per-expert PEFT upper baseline, native full LiME-style p_e. Source role is explicitly known in CPU preflight: **not** original LiME zero-param routing. Natural stage reproduce official Kowsher/LiME MMT47 code/router and its task modality tokenizer, freezing source/tag and matched VRAM before fresh. Sweep K 2/5/8/16 under new protocol, orbit-private mixing, m dimensionality 2/4/8 and rank-k matched linear native. Count routing/model/code+shared decoder and private state in exact serializer. No source model/oracle task test leak.
mandatory_native_controls: native LiME full p_e, native LiME plus ordinary same-byte linear/diagonal p-code, frozen-base LoRA/VeRA/IA3, independent MoE-PEFT, MIMO one-trunk heads
measurements: MMT-47 or matched 5-task NLL, worst task, router entropy/precision, actual paid adapter+code bytes, P95 TPOT, one shared-adapter forward count
counterhypothesis: LiME already performs all heavy PEFT sharing, and its direct per-expert vectors can be cheaper/faster at useful quality than rotating the whole adapter output. A short orthogonal rotation cannot encode arbitrary independent tasks.
uncertainty: Same-digit partitions are correlated, non-native role router in Stage0, task identity/feature confounding, optimization steps and output calibration. CI by whole world/independent task, not token; use measured bytes and seconds separately.

gates.PASS: In >=4/5 independent fresh task-world units Mirror NLL <= native LiME+0.02 nat/label, complete per-expert bytes <=0.85 native and whole model bytes <=0.97 native, P95<=1.10 native, with strict paired mean NLL <= same-byte ordinary linear/diagonal code minus 0.01. Natural benchmark + 10 independent worlds needed for ADOPTED.
gates.FAIL: Same-four-code native linear/diagonal or original LiME/one-trunk multihead dominates, role outputs collapse, speedup assumes K repeated native trunk runs, or Mirror simply reparameterizes ordinary Givens/IA3.
gates.UNCERTAIN: missing strong native reproduction, real bytes or credible natural heldout quality / intervals

adoption: independent natural >=10 task-world replications; no historical scientific status changed
